steps.en: A staff-applied suspension marks the notice as suspended
steps.id: Suspension dari staff menandai notice sebagai suspended

steps.en: A PLUS-applied suspension marks the notice the same way
steps.id: Suspension dari PLUS menandai notice dengan cara yang sama

steps.en: Reminder letters skip notices that are suspended
steps.id: Surat reminder tidak dibuat untuk notice yang suspended
steps.why_en: Letters are only generated by a manual trigger; the daily schedule does not run them.
steps.why_id: Surat hanya dibuat lewat pemicu manual; jadwal harian tidak menjalankannya.

steps.en: Suspended notices still move one stage in the vehicle-owner lookup
steps.id: Notice suspended masih pindah satu stage di pencarian pemilik kendaraan
steps.why_en: One automatic job still moves suspended notices from the owner-lookup stage to the first reminder stage.
steps.why_id: Satu job otomatis masih memindahkan notice suspended dari stage pencarian pemilik ke stage reminder pertama.

steps.en: Text and email reminders skip suspended notices, with one exception
steps.id: Pengingat SMS dan email melewati notice suspended, dengan satu pengecualian
steps.why_en: One suspension type still receives these reminders, and the channel is switched off in the production settings.
steps.why_id: Satu jenis suspension tetap menerima pengingat ini, dan salurannya dimatikan di pengaturan produksi.
